steps.hardClue: Shoot the four character tombstones in the required order.
steps.clue: Shoot the four character tombstones in the required order.

steps.hardClue: Defend the summoned ally during its ritual.
steps.clue: Defend the Keeper Protector during its ritual, then collect and play the first audio reel.

steps.hardClue: Throw the tactical Wonder Weapon into all nine holes.
steps.clue: Throw Li’l Arnies into all nine Apothicon holes, defeat the Margwas, then play the second audio reel.

steps.hardClue: Collect six scattered bones and reconstruct the body.
steps.clue: Collect six scattered bones, reconstruct S.O.P.H.I.A.’s body, then play the final audio reel.

steps.hardClue: Aim four turrets at the floating rocks, then escort the machine to the theater.
steps.clue: Aim the four Corruption Engine turrets at the floating rocks, then escort S.O.P.H.I.A. to Kino der Toten.

steps.hardClue: Use the powered teleporter to enter a bedroom and retrieve the book.
steps.clue: Teleport to Samantha’s bedroom, retrieve the Kronorium, then place it on the Kino stage.

steps.hardClue: Hatch four eggs into creatures, then use them to locate four hidden runes.
steps.clue: Hatch the four Apothicon Eggs into Gateworms and retrieve the four Runes of Creation.

steps.hardClue: Enter four symbols in the correct order, survive four enemy waves, then recover the artifact.
steps.clue: Enter the Kronorium symbols, survive the four Margwa waves, then recover the Summoning Key.

steps.hardClue: Strike seven relics around the map with the spherical artifact.
steps.clue: Strike the seven map relics with the Summoning Key.

steps.hardClue: Charge the artifact, throw it, then force the boss into the creature’s mouth.
steps.clue: Charge the Summoning Key, throw it at S.O.P.H.I.A., then force the Shadowman into the Apothicon.
